text:
I need to determine the month of the attack on Pearl Harbor.

The attack on Pearl Harbor occurred on December 7, 1941. This is a well-established historical fact. The Japanese attack on the U.S. naval base at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, happened on the morning of December 7, 1941, which led to the United States' entry into World War II.

Both other agents correctly identified December with very high confidence (0.99 and 1.00), which aligns with the historical record.

Answer: December
Confidence: 1.00
